reviewedNoAddOrDeferred: Cedar Falls and Vinton Cedar River gauges: official corridor context exists, but no station-specific recreational threshold and complete dam/portage package was established.

Boone/Goldfield, Little Sioux/Correctionville, Cedar Creek/Bussey, Chariton/Rathbun, South Fork Iowa/New Providence, and Wapsipinicon/Tripoli: bounded screens remain no-add because the gauge-to-route threshold or public endpoint package is incomplete.

Remaining Iowa opportunities in the candidate and gauge ledgers stay covered, duplicate, blocked, screened out, stale/unsupported, access-constrained, or deferred with retry conditions; no route was added solely to increase count.
